notes.title: Patch 1.7 Live!
notes.content:
Ahoy Captains,

Patch 1.7 is now live!

This patch was influenced by feedback from the Astra Protocol 2 community, and includes additional player information, and more options to control the players’ experience.

This patch brings a mix of new features, improvements, and bug fixes:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]DISABLE ALL command to cut power to all systems in a pinch
[*]ALIAS command to allow for user remapping of commands
[*]Ability to save and load ALIAS mappings
[*]CONTINUE command as a variant to the UNPAUSE command
[/list]

[h1]New Configuration Options[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ability to select feature sets of what game content does and doesn’t appear
[*]Can remap the SECOND SCREEN and EXTERNAL LOG keys
[*]Option to save EXTERNAL LOG to disk rather than sending to a printer
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bearing towards locked on object shown in SCIENCE and ORDNANCE modules
[*]Current LASER mode shown in ORDNANCE module
[*]Current FIGHTER mode shown in OPERATIONS module
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed missing and incorrectly formatted user documentation
[*]TARGET LOCK is cleared when out of RADIO range / RADIO is disabled
[*]Can no longer highlight objects out of RADIO range / when RADIO is disabled
[*]Fixed TARGET LOCK logic to relate to object to be locked on to
[/list]

We hope that these new improvements and hardcore mode offer some new and improved ways for people to enjoy Astra Protocol 2.

If you have any comments, feedback, or suggestions, please post them here or via the usual channels.

We hope you enjoy the changes and have fun with the work we've done on Astra Protocol 2.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.1.0
notes.content:
Attention Captains,

Patch 1.6.1.0 is now live. This patch focuses on improving the rendering times and bugfixes.

The changes are as follows:

[list]
[*] If not running in a window, the game will ask the user on launch whether they want to run in 800x600 mode. This lowers the resolution of the screen that the game is running on to fix issues when running at higher resolutions. Closing the game will return the resolution to normal.
[*] Planet type (terrestrial / gas giant) added to scientific readouts for planets.
[*] Fixed minor graphical issue with render modes 1 and 3 where the CRT shutdown effect didn't render properly.
[*] Shield mites can no longer be targeted by the lasers when out of range.
[*] Fixed issue where enemy ship shields could be set to NaN making them indestructible.
[*] Fighters will only target ships near the player and not fly off if the nearest target is too far away.
[*] Launching fighters when none are available is no longer a syntax error.
[/list]

We hope that these fixes improve your enjoyment of Astra Protocol 2. The rendering time has been a long running issue that we have been looking into fixing through other means, so hopefully this has now been resolved.

We also appreciate any feedback and comments. Should you have any, please leave them here or in one of the discussion posts.

notes.title: Patch 1.6 Live
notes.content:
Attention Captains,

The Patch 1.6 for Astra Protocol 2 is now live!

Star-fighters have been overhauled and new features have been programmed into the terminal.

This patch brings a mix of new features, improvements, and bug fixes:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Overhauled fighters
[*] Battleships and destroyers launch fighters
[*] Hardcore mode - type a syntax error and the ship explodes
[*] Ships can drop chaff
[*] Pause / unpause command
[/list]


[h1]New Configuration Options[/h1]
[list]
[*] Toggle to view assists which provide extra information to aid the player
[*] Toggle to remove the radiation jitter
[*] Toggle to automatically stabilise the ship if engines / thrusters / rudder set to zero
[*] Three different render modes for potentially improved rendering speeds
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] AI follow behaviour matches that of the autopilot
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when loading some space-time anomalies
[*] Fixed issue where distress beacon would always spawn at maximum range
[*] Fixed issue where autopilot wouldn’t account for planet rings correctly
[*] Fixed issue where crystalline entities wouldn’t collide with minefields correctly
[*] Fixed issue with alignment of damaged components in ship readouts
[*] Fixed hang when pressing return on opening the Help screen 
[/list]

The speed of rendering was an issue we've looked at solving. Three new rendering modes have been implemented for users to determine which work best on their system. Additionally, turning off some rendering features, such as the radiation jitter and scanlines, can provide some improvements.

Handling fighters was another key area we've been wanting to solve since launch. The way they behave now, with the removal of the friendly fire option from the previous patch, now means that they can be useful.

We've also added a few toggles to aid players.

We hope that these new improvements and hardcore mode offer some new and improved ways for people to enjoy Astra Protocol 2.

If you have any comments, feedback, or suggestions, please post them here or via the usual channels.

We hope you enjoy the changes and have fun with the work we've done on Astra Protocol 2.

notes.title: Upcoming Patch 1.6
notes.content:
Attention Captains,

Work has begun on the v1.6 patch for Astra Protocol 2.

Alongside a few bug fixes and improvements, there will be some new features added. The biggest update in this patch however is that we're looking at overhauling the fighters.

Fighters will now be distinct from ships, allowing a separation of their logic and behaviour, allowing them to be much more reliable in their usage. Additionally, enemies will react to fighters, which may be targeting them with their lasers, firing on them with their missiles, or even launching fighters of their own.

For those of you who are interested in seeing how they work and behave, we've updated the Beta branch accordingly. There's still a load of tweaks to do to them, but already they work much better - jump on the Beta branch and try them out for yourself.

As usual, please feel free to leave comments here or in the Community Feedback thread - https://steamcommunity.com/app/2026750/discussions/0/5789982181540189847/

Watch this space for further updates

notes.title: Patch 1.5 LIVE
notes.content:
Attention Captains,

The Patch 1.5 for Astra Protocol 2 is now live!

Space stations have come online and can provide benefits to you on your exploration and investigation into the Astra Protocol.

This patch brings a mix of new features, improvements and bug fixes:

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*]Can request to DRYDOCK with space station - docking will allow ship to be repaired
[*]Can request RESUPPLY from a space station - docking will resupply ship resources
[*]Space stations have resources specified on creation
[/list]

[h1]Changes and Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*]Adjusted the scan range and rate of all ships
[*]Window position is stored between sessions
[*]Optional config option to allow your missiles to hit your fighters (turned off by default)
[*]Space station spawn logic adjusted
[*]Space stations only spawn in undiscovered space - you can no longer go back and forth to find a space station that wasn’t there before
[*]Space stations shouldn’t spawn too close together
[*]Game version stored in save file
[*]Config menu rearranged to fit on smaller screens better
[/list]

[h1]Documentation[/h1]

[list]
[*]Explanation that the game uses a Newtonian physics model
[*]Explanation that long range scan uses relative and not absolute coordinates
[*]Explanation about how to reread a transmission
[*]Explanation that the TARGET option only works within a certain range
[*]New commands added to user manual
[*]New commands added to quick start guide
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Transmissions and log timestamps shouldn’t be negative on loading a save
[*]Heliosaurs can no longer spawn in empty space
[*]Missiles will complete a reload / firing operation if the game was saved and reloaded mid process
[*]Rift worms highlight properly
[*]Lasers will now lock onto all lifeforms properly
[*]Docking HUD has the port and starboard umbilicals and airlocks labelled properly
[*]Space time anomalies will now close if the game was saved and reloaded during a rift worm spawn
[*]Ordnance screen no longer displays TARGET LOCKED when no target is locked
[*]Crystalline entities will now actually spawn
[*]Fixed compass on navigation screen
[*]Fixed height bars and adjusted zoom for space stations being viewed in the scientific details screen
[*]Refuelling fighters will no longer be flagged as RETURNING when docked
[*]Fixed crash on config screen if second monitor is unplugged between sessions
[*]Links in PDF manual restored
[/list]

We hope that these improvements should enhance your experience with Astra Protocol 2 and encourage you to utilise some of the newer features implemented in earlier patches, as well as addressing some feedback we have received from players.

If you have any comments, feedback, or suggestions, please post them here or via the usual channels.

We hope you enjoy the changes and have fun with the work we've done on Astra Protocol 2.

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.4.3.0
notes.content:
Attention Captains,

We have released a Minor Patch 1.4.3.0. This is a quality of life patch, adding in a few minor features to allow captains to adjust their experience.

[list]
[*] Seeding the random number as mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2026750/view/3953664641962937126]Patch 1.4.2.0 Beta[/url]
[*] Second screen functionality. Allowing certain instrumentation to be displayed on a second screen / monitor. For more information, check out the [b]SECONDARY SCREEN[/b] section of the User Manual.
[*] Users can configure which screen the game / secondary screen launches on.
[*] Users can configure the graphical fidelity.
[*] Users can configure the screen refresh rate (independent of the game update rate).
[/list]

The option to configure graphical fidelity and screen refresh rate are consequences of the rendering used by the engine. To ensure the small file size of Astra Protocol 2 (we're only just over one megabyte in size), we are using the old and slow GDK+ libraries which can cause slowdown when running multiple monitors. Playing with these settings should allow some balance between graphics and gameplay.

We hope that you enjoy these improvements and please feel free to provide any feedback via the usual channels.

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.4.2.0 Beta
notes.content:
Attention Captains,

We have uploaded a minor version to the beta branch that allows those who are a little more technical minded to tinker with Astra Protocol 2.

There are two main components to this patch:

[list]
[*] Ability to seed the game's random numbers.
[*] Ability to configure most of the game's variables.
[/list]

The biggest change of this build is that you can set the value that the game uses to seed the random number generation, this means that on boot (and boot only) you can ensure that you always start in the same sector, location, and initial spawn without needing to mess around with save files etc. 

This can be enabled by putting the value "seed=X" (where X is a non-zero, positive number, e.g. seed=5) into the [b]Launch Options[/b] in Steam - however this only occurs on game boot. If you die and restart in the same session, you will not start in the same sector.

The other change was actually introduced into an earlier build but wasn't publicised. In this build, we've added in a [b]_config.config[/b] file that can be used to control a lot of the variables used in game, such as the algorithms generating planets, probe speed, strength of the fauna etc. If this file is renamed to [b]config.config[/b] the values in that file will override the defaults in the game. It involves playing around with xml, and also risks affecting your game experience, so use with caution.

We're leaving this in beta for a while to gauge opinion on whether we need to roll it out.

Please let us know how useful you find either of these features as it will help steer the direction of future improvements.

tags.feature: Ability to seed the game's random numbers.
Ability to configure most of the game's variables.

In this build, we've added in a [b]_config.config[/b] file that can be used to control a lot of the variables used in game, such as the algorithms generating planets, probe speed, strength of the fauna etc.

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.4.1.0
notes.content:
Minor patch to re-enable logging to a dot-matrix printer which was lost between the v1.3.1 and v1.4 patch.

To enable, you need to do some configuring of your computer - DO SO AT YOUR OWN RISK.

In a command prompt, you need to register your printer as a parallel printer:

"NET USE LPT1: \\[Computer-Name]\Printer /PERSISTENT:YES"

Then, in the Terminal Configuration (accessed using the command argument -c) you need to enable the external log and ensure it is set to LPT1:

However, for those unfortunate enough to not have 30+ year old obsolete printers, and are technically minded, this External Log can be set to any file handle.

tags.feature: Minor patch to re-enable logging to a dot-matrix printer which was lost between the v1.3.1 and v1.4 patch.

notes.title: Patch 1.4 Live
notes.content:
Attention Captains,

Patch 1.4 is now live! This is possibly the biggest patch we've released to date with over 120 tasks and bug-fixes involved.

This patch brings in a mix of new features, improvements and bug fixes:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ships can dock with space stations
[*]Ships now have a life-support you must manage
[*]New failure state - loss of life support
[*]Science missions
[*]Animation when reading transmissions from the Scientific Division
[*]New life form - Crystalline entity
[*]New life form - Rift worm
[*]New life form - Shield mites
[*]Speedometer in the Helm Module
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Space stations now have expanded scientific details
[*]Target locked objects show their trajectory in the Science Module
[*]Survivors detected on ships are displayed in the expanded scientific details
[*]Ship reactor temperatures are displayed in the expanded scientific details
[*]Expanded scientific details can be multi-page
[*]Transmissions can be multi-page
[*]Can press RETURN to load the current HELP page immediately
[*]Stars and planets display summaries of the number of planets and moons scanned
[*]Tweaked chance of space-time anomalies occurring
[*]Tweaked layout of scientific details
[*]Additional biological matter can be detected on asteroids
[*]Updated user documentation for new commands
[*]Fighters with no fuel no longer expire
[*]Space stations prevented from spawning too close together
[*]Heliosaur swarms of a certain size appear on the combat radar
[*]Tweaked collision meshes for better improvement
[*]Tweaked the effect that noise has on the missiles homing
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed rendering issue with doughnut meshes
[*]Fixed issue with heliosaurs sometimes not registering hits on a ship
[*]Fixed issue with minefields sometimes not registering hits on a ship
[*]Fixed text issue with recharging shields 
[*]Fixed graphical issue with the laser targeting appearing outside of the laser range
[*]Fixed issue with spaces in the PLOT ROUTE command causing a syntax error
[*]Fixed issue with the computer not reporting target loss
[*]Fixed issue with destroyed ship count not saving
[/list]

Thank you for the time and patience, this patch took a while to get out.

As with the other patches, the previous version is available as its own branch.

If you have any comments, feedback, or suggestions, please post them here or via the usual channels.

We hope you enjoy the changes and have fun with the work we've done on Astra Protocol 2.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 Live
notes.content:
Attention Captains.

Patch 1.3 is now live. This patch was focused mainly on improvements to the AI, quality of life improvements, and additional features

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] Player can enable Signal Jammers to increase the noise experienced by a ship
[*] Players and AI can recharge their shields back to full capacity
[*] Ships can  toggle tractor beams between repel and attract
[*] Autopilot can be set to follow the target
[*] Can automatically target lifeforms command to target living objects
[*] Can automatically target the object detected as an imminent collision
[/list]

[h1]Tweaks and Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] AI ships are given an Experience level which determines how aware they are and how they behave
[*] AI confidence algorithm tweaked
[*] The noise generated by moving at speed has been reduced
[*] Noise level shown on transmissions
[*] Missiles are fired / loaded in the order specified rather than the order they appear in menu
[*] Option to adjust the AI spawning algorithm to be based around player rank, preventing powerful ships from appearing until later (turned off by default)
[*] Ship's noise level determines chance of detecting player
[*] Space-time anomalies can close sporadically
[*] Laser array range, active, and target show on ordnance screen
[*] Warning when ship is under a tractor lock
[*] ETA removed from Navigation screen
[*] Tweaked the spawn event to keep something interesting happening nearby
[/list]

[h1]Configuration[/h1]

[list]
[*] Can override all configuration variables via a config file
[*] Can define joystick configuration
[*] Can specify secondary joystick (to allow partial HOTAS)
[*] Can run the game in a window
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the autopilot overshoots
[*] Moon orbits based on distance from planet not star
[*] Fixed exceptions when running under WINE
[*] Can specify the computer voice
[*] Can turn the computer voice off at config
[*] Ships shouldn't drop all mines in one go when retreating
[*] Thrusters apply the correct load to the reactor
[*] Fixed issue where high radiation broke the survivor system (making them 100% chance of detection)
[*] Fixed issue with end-game event spawning prematurely
[*] Fixed issue with ships doing nothing
[*] Fixed issue with SCAN SPACECRAFT detecting fighters
[/list]


Numerous save files have been tested, but if you want to keep the data, backing them up is recommended. As per the previous update, the previous patch is available as its own branch.

If you have any comments, feedback, or suggestions, please post them here or via the usual channels.

We hope you enjoy the changes and have fun with the work we've done on Astra Protocol 2.

notes.title: Patch 1.2 Live
notes.content:
Attention Captains.

Patch 1.2 is now live. This patch was focused mainly on making space travel more dynamic and adding in new features and improvements.

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*]A new sector is generated if the player flies outside the known bounds of space
[*]Minefield - Static clusters of explosive mines
[*]Rift anomalies - tears in the fabric of space-time that can appear spontaneously
[*]Heliosaur swarms - sentient migrating space reptiles that can appear on planets and asteroids

[/list]

[h1]Tweaks and Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*]General code improvements
[*]Tidied up some strings
[*]Scanning missiles reveal payload

[*]Fixed issue with autopilot and manual controls fighting

[*]Fixed issue with ship sizes not saving properly

[*]Fixed issue with objects popping in and out too soon
[*]Fixed issue with probing objects returning scan descriptions as if not probed
[*]Program splash screen background is taken from colour palette
[*]Fixed issues with retreating ships dropping all mines at once
[/list]

Numerous save files have been tested, but if you want to keep the data, backing them up is recommended. As per the previous update, the previous patch is available as its own branch.

If you have any comments, feedback, or suggestions, please post them here or via the usual channels.

We hope you enjoy the changes and have fun with the work we've done on Astra Protocol 2.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Live
notes.content:
Patch / Build 1.1 is now live. This patch constituted some functionality and graphical changes, and stability improvements.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Save and Load Functionality[/h2]
Two new commands to both save and restore progress.

[h2]Starchart[/h2]
A new screen showing a, not to scale, map of all celestial bodies and space stations that have been discovered.

[h2]Auto-pilot ETA[/h2]
The navigation screen will show an estimated value of the time remaining to reach the target destination.

[h2]TAB to auto-complete commands[/h2]
Pressing the TAB key will auto-complete and allow the user to cycle through commands and their sub-commands.

[h2]SHUTDOWN command[/h2]
Entering the SHUTDOWN command will prompt the user whether they want to exit and will close the terminal if Y is selected.. This is in addition to the Alt-F4 functionality.

[h2]Stars[/h2]
Cut from the initial release, Stars have been re-implemented.

[h2]User Manual Nudge[/h2]
To help point users towards the user manual, an appropriate flavour text is displayed in the command window on boot.

[h2]Reduced noise[/h2]
The amount of noise generated based on ship speed has been reduced.

[h2]Save Config[/h2]
The user config (enabled via a command line argument) now has the option to save between sessions.

[h2]User Manual Updates[/h2]
The user manual has been updated to reflect the above.

[h1]Graphical Changes[/h1]
[h2]Separate command window[/h2]
The command input window is now separate to the command log due to a change in how this was implemented.

[h2]Equaliser Bars[/h2] 
The signal strength display in the science module now has additional equaliser bars to help determine signal strength.

[h2]Sizing bars[/h2]
Additional size markers have been added to the expanded details screen

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h2]Enemy Ship Component Damage[/h2]
Enemy ships now take damage to their components similar to the player.

[h2]Fighter distance[/h2]
Fighters are reported as lost if they get too far from the player's ship.

[h2]Abort Self Destruct[/h2]
Aborting a self destruct that is not active will not display the message that it cannot be cancelled.

[h2]AI ship behaviour[/h2]
Fixes to some circumstances where a ship's behaviour could get stuck.
